expected_behavior_change: Every distinct formal Admin publish is accepted into Cloud canonical state on a strictly increasing Cloud publish clock.
Admin outbox drains every formal publish oldest to newest instead of collapsing to the numerically latest revision.
Rxx/revision is diagnostic metadata only and never decides which Admin data is newer.
Every Admin publish rings the existing doorbell; SMT pulls the same canonical endpoint and applies by publishedAt plus fingerprint.
Rapid repeated publishes such as every ten seconds remain separate formal publishes and are delivered sequentially.
SMT ACK identifies the exact canonical fingerprint and publishedAt that was applied.
Admin and SMT human-facing status use publish/applied/readback time vocabulary instead of Rxx as truth.
Reconnect/focus/pageshow/visibility recovery reuses the same canonical pull path without an interval polling engine.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta, Customer, SMM or Owner authority change.
No destructive SMT transaction or config reset.
